zh.docTitle: 万物生物 · Life of Everything | 生命通识科普
zh.docDesc: 用通识的方式梳理生命：主要类群、生态系统、演化里程碑与生物学家。中立、结构化、中英双语、免费无广告。
zh.heroSub: 从细胞到生物圈，从演化长河到生命之树——把生命的多样性讲成看得懂的常识。中立、结构化、中英双语、免费无广告。

zh.schools.sub: 从哺乳纲到原生生物界，建立对生命多样性的整体认知。点击卡片看详解。
zh.questions.title: 生态系统
zh.questions.sub: 雨林、草原、荒漠、深海……同一颗地球，生命如何在不同环境中安家。每个系统列出分布、特征与为何重要。
zh.principles.title: 生命原理
zh.principles.sub: 从细胞到生态，生命如何获取能量、传递遗传、演化适应并自我调节。点击卡片看机制与要点。
zh.classics.title: 演化里程碑
zh.classics.sub: 从生命起源、光合作用到人类出现——读懂生命如何在数十亿年里一步步成形。
zh.thinkers.title: 生物学家

zh.glossary.title: 生物术语

zh.myths.title: 常见误区
zh.myths.sub: 「人类由黑猩猩进化而来」「用进废退会遗传」……流传已久的生物学说法，哪些是误解？逐条拆解。

zh.quiz.title: 小测验
zh.quiz.sub: 12 道题覆盖细胞、遗传与生态：每题有提示、选项（✓ 标出正确答案）与解析。先答，再点开对。
zh.timeline.title: 认知生命时间线

en.docTitle: Life of Everything | A Plain-Language Guide to Life
en.docDesc: Life made plain: major groups, ecosystems, evolutionary milestones and the biologists behind them. Bilingual and ad-free.
en.heroSub: From cells to the biosphere, from evolution's river to the tree of life — the diversity of life in plain language. Neutral, structured, bilingual and free of ads.
en.heroIssue: Found a problem or have a suggestion? Open an issue or send an email:
en.mail.subject: [Life of Everything] Feedback / Suggestion
en.mail.body:
Hi,

I would like to share feedback / a suggestion:
(please describe briefly)

—— Page / module / location:
(e.g. Major Groups - Mammalia)

—— Expected improvement (optional):

Thanks!
en.homeLead: From groups to ecosystems, from evolution to people — pick a section to begin your journey.
en.refsSub: An educational summary; key claims are sourced. For learning only, not professional advice.
en.entry.schools.d: From mammals to bacteria: eight representative groups, traits and roles
en.entry.questions.d: Rainforest, reef, tundra, deep sea — how life organizes its homes
en.entry.principles.d: Cells, metabolism, heredity, evolution, ecology and physiology — how life works
en.entry.classics.d: From life's origin to humans: the turning points that shaped the biosphere
en.entry.thinkers.d: Darwin, Linnaeus, Mendel — how they uncovered life's rules
en.entry.glossary.d: Alleles, niches, succession — what the textbook words precisely mean
en.entry.myths.d: Popular myths about living things, checked one by one against the evidence
en.entry.experiments.d: Willow pots, density gradients, phage blenders — the experiments that reshaped biology
en.entry.compare.d: Photosynthesis and respiration, mitosis and meiosis—paired concepts laid out until the mix-ups unmix
en.entry.quiz.d: Twelve quick biology checks: think first, then open for options, the marked answer and the why
en.entry.timeline.d: From Aristotle's animals to the human genome draft: biology's turning points back in their time
en.entry.endemics.d: Giant panda, ginkgo, dawn redwood, crested ibis — life that evolved on Chinese soil
en.schools.title: Major Groups
en.schools.sub: From Mammalia to Protista — build a whole picture of life's diversity. Tap a card for details.
en.questions.title: Ecosystems
en.questions.sub: Rainforest, grassland, desert, deep sea — how life makes a home in each setting. Each lists distribution, traits and why it matters.
en.principles.title: Life Principles
en.principles.sub: From cells to ecosystems — how life captures energy, passes on heredity, adapts and self-regulates. Tap a card for the mechanism and key points.
en.classics.title: Evolutionary Milestones
en.classics.sub: From the origin of life and photosynthesis to humans — how life took shape over billions of years.
en.thinkers.title: Biologists
en.thinkers.sub: Darwin, Linnaeus, Mendel, Watson & Crick — how each uncovered life's rules.
en.glossary.title: Biology Terms
en.glossary.sub: The most easily confused words in cell biology, genetics and ecology: agree on the language first, then discuss life. Tap a term for its definition and a plain-language version.
en.myths.title: Misconceptions
en.myths.sub: Humans evolved from chimpanzees, use-it-or-lose-it traits are inherited — which long-circulated claims about life are misunderstandings? Debunked one by one.
en.experiments.title: Classic Experiments
en.compare.title: Biology Contrasts
en.compare.sub: Photosynthesis versus respiration, DNA versus RNA—the more two ideas resemble each other, the easier to confuse. Side by side for the differences, then a bridge for the links.
en.quiz.title: Quiz
en.quiz.sub: Twelve questions on cells, heredity and ecology: each carries a hint, options (✓ marks the answer) and an explanation. Answer first, open after.
en.timeline.title: Timeline of Biology
en.timeline.sub: Twelve moments from Aristotle's animals to the human genome draft, stringing together the turning points of biology. Tap for what led to each and what followed.
en.experiments.sub: Most textbook conclusions trace back to one or two cleverly designed experiments. In chronological order: how they were done, what was seen, what it meant.
en.endemics.title: Endemic Species of China
en.endemics.sub: From flagship animals to living fossils: their traits, range and conservation status.
